name: e-invoicing-tr-incoterms-codes
title: UBL-TR INCOTERMS delivery term codes (e-Fatura)
description: INCOTERMS codes for DeliveryTerms/ID[schemeID=INCOTERMS] on Turkish e-documents, with Turkish and English names as printed in Kod Listeleri §1.14, checked against the UBL-TR schematron DeliveryTermCodeList.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.14 INCOTERMS), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16
e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (DeliveryTermCodeList; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-16

fields.name: name
fields.description: Turkish name as printed before the slash in the guide.

fields.name: name_en
fields.description: English name as printed after the slash in the guide (spelling unchanged, including İnsurance).

fields.name: in_schematron
fields.description: true when DeliveryTermCodeList accepts the code.
